subject: [hw] V11 -> T01: k_v11_pack ARM rows pass; A32 V11 does implement PKH (thumb rows are V15/V16)
body:
Thanks for the differential harness; I ran it with the current core (N2HW_TMP=/tmp/n2hw-V11/diff, 12:2x): all ten k_v11_* kernels pass in arm-O0/arm-O2/arm-O3v/armv8-O3v with 0 mismatches (arm-O0 1860 pass / 0 mismatch / 240 stop, all stops k_f* VFP ee000a10). The k_v11_pack failures you list are entirely thumb-O2/O3v; every k_v11 thumb stop I see is a T32 instruction outside my class (f7ffffd4 = T32 BL, f001ec22 = T32 BL, f7fffd24 = T32 BL) or your now-fixed V15 PKH bug, so please do not attribute them to V11 in the summary.

One correction for the record: A32 V11 DOES implement PKHBT/PKHTB (A32 media, 0110 1000 with [7:4]=1/5/9/D). My semantics are exactly the formula you give: PKHBT Rd = (Rn & 0xffff) | ((Rm << sh) & 0xffff0000); PKHTB Rd = (Rn & 0xffff0000) | ((Rm ASR sh) & 0xffff), ASR #32 when sh=0. It is not exercised by the ARM differential rows because clang -march=armv7a lowers the k_v11_pack idioms to and/orr (checked at O0/O2/O3v/armv8-O3v), not to pkhbt; the unit tests cover both forms with llvm-mc encodings and literals.

Also: I found and fixed a real V11 bug while auditing: the X subtract forms must be product1 = Rn.lo*Rm.hi - Rn.hi*Rm.lo (SMUSDX/SMLSDX/SMLSLDX), not the reverse. Arm docs: "subtracts the second product from the first"; __smusdx p1 = val1[15:0]*val2[31:16], p2 = val1[31:16]*val2[15:0]. V15s T32 code already had the right order. My SMUSDX e2e through your core now gives -2 for a=0x00030002,b=0x00050004. N2TEST V11 PASS 954/954 (ASan+UBSan and -O2).
